title: Halo: Combat Evolved Mobile (HCEMobile)
description: Halo CE as an installable web app for iPhone/Android; play in the browser or add to home screen.

title: Quake III Arena (q3.pieter.com)
description: Quake III multiplayer in the browser (unofficial, non-commercial).

title: WASM Arcade (GTA / Minecraft web ports)
description: Collection of WebAssembly game ports incl. GTA and Minecraft builds.

title: Claude of Duty: Vibe Slops II (froydinger mirror)
description: Unofficial mirror of the taken-down original (removed after a copyright notice). AI-built Three.js reconstruction of Black Ops II multiplayer (listed as 'Black Ops 2' in the X post).

title: Claude of Duty: Vibe Slops II (GoofyAhhBro69420 mirror)
description: Unofficial mirror of the taken-down original (removed after a copyright notice). AI-built Three.js reconstruction of Black Ops II multiplayer (Hijacked, Nuketown).

title: Kino der Toten (theeagler1234 mirror)
description: Unofficial mirror of the taken-down original (removed after a copyright notice). Three.js reconstruction of the Black Ops Zombies map, solo survival.

title: Kino der Toten (GoofyAhhBro69420 mirror)
description: Unofficial mirror of the taken-down original (removed after a copyright notice). Three.js reconstruction of the Black Ops Zombies map, solo survival.

title: Quiver Launcher
description: MIT-licensed launcher (Windows/macOS/Linux/Android) that installs and updates upstream releases of decomp, recomp and source-port projects. Needs your own game files.

title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 (IW4L)
description: Standalone experimental MW2 runtime written from scratch in Rust (bevy + wgpu). Needs your own copy of MW2.

title: Skate 3 (Skate 3 Rust Engine)
description: Rust + Bevy skating engine based on Skate 3 reverse-engineering research. Needs your own Xbox 360 copy; no assets included.

title: World of Warcraft 1.12 (benilla)
description: A World of Warcraft 1.12.1 client written from scratch in Rust and Bevy. Needs your own game data.

title: libsm64
description: Super Mario 64 as a library for external game engines, built from the SM64 decompilation. Extracts assets from your own ROM. Powers most Mario-in-X mods.

title: ER Mario
description: Mario's triple jumps, wall kicks, long jumps, ground pounds, attacks, health wedges, coins and Lakitu-style camera run through libsm64 while Elden Ring supplies the world, enemies, encounters and live Havok collision.

title: Retro64
description: Retro64 uses a libsm64 fork to simulate Super Mario 64's movement code in Minecraft, toggled with the M key. Mario can attack mobs, swim, take damage, travel between dimensions and use the wing cap via elytra. Still actively released in 2026 (1.2.5, 27 Sep 2026).
host: Minecraft: Java Edition (Forge 1.20.1 and below; NeoForge 1.21.1+)

title: G64
description: G64 is a Garry's Mod addon that uses ckosmic's fork of libsm64 to run Super Mario 64's decompiled movement code inside Source maps. It includes the full moveset, wing/metal/vanish caps, coins, multiplayer, gamepad and vehicle support. Assets are extracted at runtime from a user-s

title: sm64-san-andreas (Super Mario 64 in GTA San Andreas)
description: Headshotnoby's plugin embeds libsm64 into GTA San Andreas so Mario moves with SM64's physics through Los Santos. It is one of a family of libsm64 ports by the same author (ClassiCube, OpenLara/Tomb Raider, GZDoom, DDNet). Latest release is v20250505.
host: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas (PC v1.0)

title: SMC64 — Mario in Halo: CE
description: A libsm64-based mod that runs SM64's Mario movement inside Halo CE in the Master Chief Collection. The latest alpha came out on 1 Oct 2026.

title: gzdoom-sm64 — Mario in Doom
description: A fork of GZDoom 3.2.0 that swaps the Doom player for a playable Super Mario 64 Mario driven by libsm64, moving with SM64's physics through Doom maps. The creator describes it as a work in progress and publishes a development build.

title: Doom-in-Doom
description: kgsws found a code-execution vulnerability in DOS DOOM2.EXE and used it to load a Chocolate Doom port that renders to a texture inside the host game, effectively a cinema room showing a playable Doom. The same technique was shown running Heretic. The exploit work became the ACE E

title: UltraDoom / UltrakillDoom
description: Turns ULTRAKILL's diegetic shop terminals into playable DOOM instances. A legitimate or shareware DOOM WAD is supplied by the user.

title: 2010 Rust Rewrite Mashup
description: A from-scratch Rust rewrite of MW2 that combines MW2 multiplayer, Skate 3-style skating and a real generated Minecraft world. The Minecraft mode includes blocks, mobs, inventory, mining/placing and world generation; Skate mode uses data from a user-owned Xbox 360 copy. v0.4.0 (2
host: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 via IW4L

title: SkateGM
description: Runs Skate 3's board physics, tricks and scoring on Garry's Mod maps, with multiplayer, minigames, a park editor and a dedicated skating gamemode. Users supply their own Skate 3 files.

title: SkyCraft
description: Minecraft remains running as the game-logic side while Skyrim renders the world. Movement, inventory, HUD, blocks, digging, fluids, lighting, combat and parts of Minecraft progression are integrated into Skyrim's world.
host: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition

title: VM Computers
description: A Fabric mod in which players order computer parts from an in-game satellite and assemble a computer that runs a real VirtualBox virtual machine, displayed and controlled in the Minecraft world. Coverage and creator footage show DOS Doom being played on these in-game PCs.
guest: x86 operating systems and their games (e.g. DOS Doom) via VirtualBox

title: Ultracraft
description: A Fabric mod plus a BepInEx plugin (UltraBridge) that runs ULTRAKILL alongside Minecraft 1.21.11 and draws it into Minecraft's window. Minecraft's blocks and mobs become ULTRAKILL's world and enemies; the README documents bosses, layer-themed arenas, the shop and upgrades, Cyber

title: hytale2mc
description: A framework for writing one minigame that runs across Minecraft and Hytale with synchronized game state. The project site currently advertises a live public server at `play.hytale2mc.com`.

title: CrossplayProject — Minecraft ↔ Roblox
description: Synchronizes blocks, players, mobs, time/weather, chat, skins and build/break interactions between Minecraft and Roblox. The source repository is archived, but the v1.3 release remains available.
host: Linked Minecraft server and Roblox experience

title: HyCraft
description: Minecraft clients can connect to a Hytale server without a client mod. HyCraft converts chunks and biomes, synchronises entities and inventory, and translates block interaction and combat.

title: Skate
description: Static recompilation of skate (2007, Xbox 360) to native Windows via the ReXGlue SDK. Career, Freeskate, videos and audio work at 60 FPS. Needs your own Xbox 360 copy; no game files included.

title: Skate 2
description: Static recompilation of Skate 2 (Xbox 360) to native Windows via the ReXGlue SDK. Boots through the menus into Freeskate with working mission triggers; early. Needs your own Xbox 360 copy; no game files included.
